manifest.name: m3v2-agent-04-ks-understeer-lag-perseg-delta0
manifest.description: Speed-known bicycle-like reconstruction with understeer (K_us), first-order lag (tau), per-segment delta0 estimated from input channels only. Mach-E and IONIQ-5 use per-segment delta0; Lightning uses global delta0. Tesla falls back to V0 passthrough.
